noveltyItems.ocrTitle: Real PDF OCR Text Extraction & Confidence Scoring
noveltyItems.ocrDesc: Native pdf-parse buffer stream parsing extracts certificate numbers, validity dates, and issuing authorities from Land Titles, Building Plans, and Fire Safety NOCs with algorithmic confidence verification (≥ 85%).
noveltyItems.evcDesc: Strictly enforces APH 2026-27 Section 2.4. Mathematically blocks appointments if an empanelled expert has prior employment, research affiliation, or regional proximity to the applicant institution.
noveltyItems.slaDesc: Proactive background sweep engine detects pending applications and triggers tiered supervisor alerts (3d to Bureau Officer → 7d to Regional Director → 14d to Central Council HQ) to eliminate bottlenecks.
noveltyItems.aiDesc: Context-grounded assistant quoting exact AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH 2026-27) clauses, land norms, and faculty cadre formulas in English, Hindi (हिन्दी), and Marathi (मराठी).
noveltyItems.compDesc: Decouples annual EoA filings from round-the-year safety mandates. Continuously monitors Anti-Ragging Committees, POSH/ICC, Grievance Ombudsman, and Faculty Cadre ratios (1:15 / 1:20).
noveltyItems.auditDesc: Every state machine transition, document validation, and officer action is cryptographically recorded with actor ID, IP address, and timestamp for Chief Vigilance Officer oversight.
